name: Local Whisper
adds: Mic buttons in text boxes, transcribed on this Mac. Fallback: macOS dictation.
note: whisper.cpp publishes no macOS command-line build (its v1.9.5 release has no downloads). Use an existing whisper-cli, e.g. from Homebrew's whisper-cpp.

name: Whisper model
adds: The speech model Local Whisper runs: OpenAI's Whisper base.en converted to ggml by whisper.cpp.

name: GitHub CLI
adds: Import a GitHub token from gh instead of pasting one. Issues work without it.

name: Kokoro voice
adds: Natural read-back voices. Fallback: macOS voices.
licence: Apache-2.0 (pulls in GPL espeak-ng and phonemizer, installed separately)
advanced: Installs a private Python environment with a standalone uv binary into ~/.myide/components.
sizeNote: Model 327 MB and uv 17 MB, plus Python packages

name: Qwen3-TTS
adds: Reads back in your own voice from a recorded sample.
advanced: Installs a private Python environment with a standalone uv binary into ~/.myide/components.
sizeNote: Model 3.8 GB and uv 17 MB, plus Python packages
